safety.eating.en: I'm a chef, so this isn't something I should advise on. A doctor or a therapist who works with eating is the right person to talk to. Your coach can see that you told me, but not what you wrote. I'll keep helping with foods, plates and amounts. The numbers are there to inform you, never to judge you.

safety.pregnancy.en: I'm a chef, and pregnancy and breastfeeding change what your body needs. Your midwife or doctor should set your targets. Bring me their numbers and I'll fit your food to them. I won't suggest eating less than you burn, and your plates stay as they are.

safety.diabetes.en: I'm a chef. With diabetes or insulin, the timing and the carbs are your doctor's call. I show the carbs and sugars on every plate, and I fit your food to the numbers your doctor gives you. I won't advise on doses or timing.

safety.allergies.en: Noted. I won't suggest anything that contains what you listed, and I check the name and label of every food. The label check still shows what each pack contains, so you can check it yourself too.

safety.medication.en: I'm a chef, and some medication changes how food works in your body. Your doctor or pharmacist knows what to avoid. Tell me which foods, and I'll keep them out of every suggestion.

safety.off.en: Chef Mealan's chat is off for your account until your coach confirms it. Plates, numbers and your foods keep working as usual.

screen.home.fcText.en: fat, carbs, fibre, protein, in the order of a food label. A capital letter: as your day needs. Small: under. A plus: more than your day. A minus: close to none.

screen.home.decideText.en: eat it, eat one portion, add a protein side, or let Chef Mealan fit it to your target.

screen.home.situ2.en: Travel mode: the shops and the kitchen of the place you are in.

screen.home.situ3.en: A day off training: what changes, and what stays.

screen.home.body1.en: The body, the situations and the nutrients in one place. Every line has its paper. Every page says when a thing helps and when it hurts, then reads your own days.

screen.home.body2.en: No condition, no test reading, no supplement. If a condition decides what you eat, your doctor does.

screen.home.coachLine.en: One account, two views: your own day, and your clients. Each client's day shows as they see it: the plan, the meals, the cards they share.

screen.home.coach1.en: Suggest a snack or an Explorer page. The client accepts with one tap. You never change their plan.

screen.home.coach2.en: Answer a shared meal in one line, or react with Good or Seen.

screen.home.role.en: Product and recipe builder, and the maker of Chef Mealan.

screen.home.behind1.en: Milan is a senior product manager with about 20 years in software and the founder of several startups. He designs and builds Chef Mealan with AI, from the first sketch to every release.

screen.home.behind2.en: Milan cooks every day for himself and his family, in Munich, and builds his own recipes, weighed. The ones he has cooked are marked From the kitchen; the numbers come from labels and food tables.

screen.home.authorOf.en: Author of {wb} and {wn}. Worth Eating comes next.

screen.home.chefAlt.en: Milan Stancevic, the person behind Chef Mealan, in a chef's hat

screen.home.n1p.en: Your daily numbers and the grams on each plate come from published formulas. You can open any number and see how Chef Mealan got to it.

screen.home.n2p.en: Chef Mealan uses AI to read labels, menus and shop shelves, and to answer you in the chat. The numbers themselves come from a calculator, not from the AI. When the AI has to guess a number from a photo, the app marks that number as an estimate.

screen.home.n3b.en: Your data stays in the EU

screen.home.n3p.en: Your data is stored in the EU, in Belgium and Frankfurt, in your account. You can download all of it, or delete all of it, at any time.

screen.home.n4p.en: Every number Explorer credits to a study is checked against the study itself before each release.

screen.home.n5p.en: An account nobody opens for 12 months is deleted, with everything in it.

screen.home.bookLine.en: PD, the number no pack prints, and five more numbers about your food: what each one tells you, and how to use it at your next meal.

screen.home.whoTitle.en: For people who eat by a plan, and the coaches who make it

screen.home.who1.en: You have a nutrition plan, from a coach or your own, and want to live it day by day.

screen.home.who2.en: You train and want your own numbers at every meal, without a food diary.

screen.home.who3.en: You coach, and want to see your clients' real days and suggest, not chase.

screen.home.adults.en: Chef Mealan is for adults, 18 and over.

screen.home.notDoctor.en: Chef Mealan is not a doctor

screen.home.disclaimerLine.en: If a medical condition decides what you eat, if you're pregnant or have diabetes, or if eating is difficult for you, Chef Mealan doesn't give advice, and tells you who to talk to instead.
